Hi Samira / Tom,

Quick note ahead of our scheduled demo next week. The US spring-forward clock change is on Sun, 14 Mar — that will temporarily shift our US->APAC overlap by one hour. I was looking at the current invite (Thu 18 Mar, 9:00 PT / Fri 19 Mar, 05:00 NZDT) and want to confirm that the previously agreed slot still works for your teams once the US clocks move.

Options that keep the demo within APAC business hours and a tolerable US morning slot:
- Thu 18 Mar, 08:00 PT / Fri 19 Mar, 04:00 NZDT (30–45 min earlier for US)
- Thu 18 Mar, 10:00 PT / Fri 19 Mar, 06:00 NZDT (push 1 hour later for APAC)
- Move to Wed 17 Mar, 16:00 PT / Thu 18 Mar, 12:00 NZDT (if you prefer a daytime APAC slot)

If any of these look better, I can send an updated calendar invite and attach the latest slide deck + invite ICS. If you'd prefer to keep the original and swallow the offset, that's fine too — just want to avoid people showing up at 4am local time by accident.

Thanks,
